concept: SCDynamicStore and NWPathMonitor event-driven change detection replacing fixed-interval probing
summary: Source-anchored research for SCDynamicStore and NWPathMonitor event-driven change detection replacing fixed-interval probing. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: NWPathMonitor reports path status (satisfied, unsatisfied, requiresConnection), interface types, isExpensive/isConstrained, and supportsIPv4/supportsIPv6/supportsDNS; it calls pathUpdateHandler on the monitor's dispatch queue when the path changes. (medium confidence)

In one third-party sandbox (Claude Code's profile, not the Mac App Store App Sandbox), SCDynamicStoreCreate returned NULL because the Mach service com.apple.SystemConfiguration.configd was blocked; this shows SCDynamicStore depends on configd IPC but says nothing definitive about App Sandbox. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-02)

Apple DTS (2018) says both SCNetworkReachability and NWPathMonitor can give false positives and false negatives and suffer TOCTTOU, so use path events as a hint and confirm with a real operation rather than gating behavior on them. (low confidence)

SCDynamicStore change detection from Python: create a store with a callback, call SCDynamicStoreSetNotificationKeys for keys like State:/Network/Global/IPv4 and State:/Network/Global/IPv6, add the store's run-loop source to a CFRunLoop; under PyObjC the context argument is an arbitrary Python object. (medium confidence)
